n.exclusions: General funneling removed two participants unable to mentally time travel and two unable to write about a scenario (p. 38). Main results explicitly described as pre-exclusion on p. 37; subsequent supplementary exclusions are not applied to these printed tests.

reported_success.quote: In terms of intensity of emotion, we found no empirical support for the asymmetry in all three scenarios.

notes:
Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling. Authors describe absence of support for asymmetry; this is their narrative verdict even though original unpleasantness contrast was also nonsignificant.
Completion source review (n_o): Explicit resulting analysis N after both stated exclusions; applies to both target outcomes.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Printed d for predicted versus remembered menstrual unpleasantness.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Printed exact p from the same t test as the extracted d.
